mapper.select: select count(*) from ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_base where user_id = #{userId} and user_pay_passwd != ''
select count(user_pay_passwd) from ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_user_base where user_id= #{userId} and user_pay_passwd=#{passwd}

SELECT oob.order_id AS orderId, oob.buyer_user_name AS buyerUserName, oob.order_receiver_name AS orderReceiverName, oob.order_receiver_address AS orderReceiverAddress, oob.order_receiver_contact AS orderReceiverContact, pbd.district_code AS provinceCode, cbd.district_code AS cityCode, abd.district_code AS areaCode, oob.order_source AS orderSource FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_district pbd ON oob.order_receiver_province_id = pbd.district_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_district cbd ON oob.order_receiver_city_id = cbd.district_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_district abd ON oob.order_receiver_area_id = abd.district_id where (oob.payment_number = #{orderId} or oob.order_id = #{orderId})

SELECT og.order_goods_num AS goodsQty, sgy.sku_id AS skuId from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_supplier_goods_yiyatong sgy on sgy.goods_id=og.goods_id and sgy.shop_id = og.shop_id where og.order_id=#{orderId} and sgy.is_delete=0
